exact.放弃本局并诚实结算: Abort this run and settle honestly
exact.运行 recap 查看结算。: Run recap to read the settlement.
exact.运行 `actions` 查看当前合法动作。: Run `actions` to see the legal moves.
exact.这一局还没有结束，以下只是当前局面。: This run is still going; what follows is the current situation only.
exact.石板路被水汽泡得发亮，米铺门口排着队，人人都在说那支笔。: The flagstones shine with steam. A line waits at the rice shop, and everyone is talking about that brush.
exact.半截无字碑歪在风里，坡下的土颜色比别处深。: A half stele with no inscription leans in the wind. The soil below is darker than elsewhere.
exact.船不靠岸，船夫只卖干粮，然后指一指雾里。: The boat does not dock. The ferryman only sells rations, then points into the fog.
exact.池水黑得能照见别人，听久了会听见有人在低声念你的名字。: The pool is black enough to reflect someone else. Listen long enough and you hear a voice murmur your name.
exact.供桌被搬空了，墙上还留着没抄完的经，墨迹是新的。: The altar has been cleared. An unfinished sutra remains on the wall, the ink still fresh.
exact.驿丞不问来路，只问你要递名帖，还是要打点。: The clerk does not ask where you came from — only whether you will present a name card, or grease a palm.
exact.你信，所以你已经在路上。信让你看得见线索，也让你更容易把假话当真。: You believe, so you are already on the road. Belief lets you see leads — and makes it easier to take a lie for truth.
exact.你不信。你带够了钱、算好了路，打算把每一条传闻都验一遍。: You do not believe. You brought enough silver and planned the road, and you mean to test every rumor.
exact.你半信半疑，但你带着笔和纸。无论笔是真是假，这趟都值得写下来。: You half believe, but you brought brush and paper. True or false, the journey is worth writing down.
exact.在米铺接零工: Take odd jobs at the rice shop
exact.扛半天米袋，换几个铜钱和一点脸熟。每人只肯雇你一次。: Haul sacks for half a day for a few coins and a familiar face. Each person will hire you only once.
exact.你扛了半天米袋，掌心磨破，换到 5 银和一点脸熟。: You haul sacks until your palms split, and earn 5 silver and a familiar face.
exact.镇上粮价随年月浮动，一次补 6 粮。: Town grain prices shift with the years. One sack restores 6 food.
exact.你把粮袋甩上肩，袋子比看上去沉。: You swing the sack onto your shoulder. It is heavier than it looked.
exact.问坡上的牧人: Ask the herder on the slope
exact.他见过夜里发光的土，也见过有人挖到一半就跑。: He has seen the soil glow at night, and seen people run off halfway through a dig.
exact.牧人说他爷爷见过那支笔落下，说完又低头赶羊。: The herder says his grandfather saw that brush fall, then lowers his head and drives the sheep on.
exact.拾坡后的野果: Pick wild fruit behind the slope
exact.酸，但能填肚子。: Sour, but it fills the stomach.
exact.你摘了一兜野果，酸的，至少能撑一阵。: You pick a pocket of wild fruit. Sour, but it will hold you for a while.
exact.两银换五天份的干粮。: Two silver for five days of rations.
exact.船夫递来油纸包，顺手把船撑远了半丈。: The ferryman hands you an oil-paper packet and poles the boat half a length farther out.
exact.听船夫讲雾里的事: Hear the ferryman talk about the fog
exact.他讲了三十年，故事越讲越短。: He has told it for thirty years. The story only gets shorter.
exact.船夫说，雾里有一支笔在等人来写；你记下了一页。: The ferryman says a brush in the fog is waiting for someone to write. You take down a page.
exact.俯身听墨声: Lean in and hear the ink
exact.会听见有人念你的名字，也会掉一段命。: You will hear someone say your name, and you will lose some life.
exact.池水念了你的名字。你站起来时，手在抖。: The pool said your name. When you stand, your hands are shaking.
exact.取一壶池水: Draw a jug of pool water
exact.水能喝，喝完嘴里发苦。: It is drinkable. Afterward the mouth is bitter.
exact.你灌了一壶，水苦得像药，喝完胃里发凉。: You fill a jug. The water is bitter as medicine, and the stomach goes cold after it.
exact.验一验庙里的残墨: Examine the leftover ink in the temple
exact.三银换一份能对得上的证据。: Three silver for a piece of evidence that can be matched.
exact.你把残墨刮进纸里，对着光看，墨色里有极细的金。: You scrape leftover ink onto paper and hold it to the light. There is a thread of gold in the black.
exact.替人抄一页经: Copy a page of sutra for someone
exact.香客给钱，抄经让人心静。: A pilgrim pays. Copying steadies the mind.
exact.你抄完一页，手腕发酸，心里却静了一点。: You finish a page. The wrist aches, but the mind is a little quieter.
exact.有名望的人才递得进去；换银，也换更大的名。: Only someone with a name gets in. It pays silver, and a larger name.
exact.驿丞看了你的名帖，把你请进侧厅喝了盏茶，走时塞了 6 银。: The clerk reads your card, invites you into a side hall for tea, and slips you 6 silver as you leave.
exact.三银换一个能进出的名字。: Three silver for a name that can come and go.
exact.驿丞收了银子，把你的名字写进一册没人翻的簿子。: The clerk takes the silver and writes your name into a register no one turns.
exact.你挖到指节发白，只翻出湿土、碎瓦和一枚锈钉。: You dig until the knuckles go white, and turn up only wet earth, broken tile, and a rusty nail.
exact.土很实。你换了个方向再挖，还是什么都没有。: The earth is hard. You change direction and dig again. Still nothing.
exact.你挖了半夜，坑底渗出水来。笔不在这一锹里。: You dig half the night. Water seeps into the pit. The brush is not in this spadeful.
exact.你顺着痕迹走了一圈，只找到半句被人擦掉的话。: You follow the traces in a circle and find only half a sentence someone wiped away.
exact.有人比你先到过，留下的只有脚印和灰。: Someone was here before you. They left only footprints and ash.
exact.这一局已经收尾了，用 recap 查看结算。: This run has ended; use recap to read the settlement.
exact.花二银问人、看土、翻旧账。信得越深，越容易听见你想听的话。: Spend two silver to ask, look at the soil, and turn old ledgers. The deeper you believe, the easier it is to hear what you want to hear.
exact.你认定的地方就挖下去。挖错也要掉一条命，文案不会告诉你错在哪。: Dig where you have decided. A wrong dig still costs a life, and the text will not tell you where you went wrong.
exact.在荒庙验这条线索: Verify this lead at the deserted temple
exact.拿残墨和旧账对一遍。验真涨证，验假掉信。: Match leftover ink against old ledgers. A true lead raises proof; a false one lowers belief.
exact.请庙里的人验这支笔: Ask someone in the temple to examine the brush
exact.写下「他还活着」。命 +2，墨债 +1。: Write "He is still alive." Life +2, ink debt +1.
exact.写下「此箱有银」。银 +10，墨债 +1。: Write "There is silver in this chest." Silver +10, ink debt +1.
exact.抹掉一个人的名字，换名望 +3、银 +6，墨债 +2。: Erase a person's name for fame +3, silver +6, and ink debt +2.
exact.把笔卖给出价的人: Sell the brush to the highest bidder
exact.一次换 25 银与 4 点名望。这笔会记住你，下一个人会更难找到它。: Once, for 25 silver and 4 fame. The brush will remember you, and the next person will have a harder time finding it.
exact.封笔，谁也不给: Seal the brush and give it to no one
exact.把笔封进匣子里。名望 +6，若一路无债还有额外评价。: Seal the brush in a case. Fame +6, and an extra remark if you carried no debt the whole way.
exact.银不够，打听不起。: Not enough silver to ask around.
exact.你手里没有可验的线索。: You have no lead to verify.
exact.对不上。那张纸上的墨是新的，话是别人编的（信 -8）。: It does not match. The ink on that paper is new, and the words were made up (belief -8).
exact.银不够，请不动庙里的人。: Not enough silver to move anyone in the temple.
exact.第三次验完，庙里的人把笔还给你，手在抖：这笔是真的。你现在可以落笔了。: After the third examination, someone in the temple returns the brush, hands shaking: it is genuine. You can write now.
exact.你只剩一条命，再挖就回不来了。: You have only one life left. Dig again and you will not come back.
exact.锹碰到硬东西。你扒开土，摸到一支笔，笔杆是温的。: The spade hits something hard. You clear the soil and feel a brush. The shaft is warm.
exact.你几乎立刻知道它是真的——不是因为它发光，而是因为你想不出别的解释。: You almost know at once that it is genuine — not because it glows, but because you cannot think of another explanation.
exact.你说不清它是不是真的。要验，去荒庙；要试，得先验。: You cannot say whether it is genuine. To examine it, go to the deserted temple; to try it, you must verify it first.
exact.这个人已经被你问过了。: You have already asked this person.
exact.这支笔还没验明，写不出东西。: This brush has not been verified. It can write nothing.
exact.你写下「他还活着」。胸口的闷痛退了，墨债 +1。: You write "He is still alive." The tightness in the chest recedes. Ink debt +1.
exact.你写下「此箱有银」。袖子里多了一锭，墨债 +1。: You write "There is silver in this chest." An ingot appears in your sleeve. Ink debt +1.
exact.你抹掉一个名字。街上有人忽然忘了自己要去找谁，墨债 +2。: You erase a name. In the street, someone suddenly forgets whom they were going to find. Ink debt +2.
exact.笔尖渗出黑水，你咳出一口墨。反噬，命 -2。: Black water seeps from the tip. You cough up ink. Backlash: life -2.
exact.墨债已经开始咬人。: The ink debt has begun to bite.
exact.你写下的字开始反过来写你。墨从七窍里漫出来。: The words you wrote begin to write you back. Ink wells from the seven openings.
exact.你被自己的墨淹没了。: You are drowned in your own ink.
exact.你把笔卖给了出价最高的人。走出皇驿时，你想起自己再也不会用笔了。: You sell the brush to the highest bidder. Leaving the imperial post, you realize you will never use a brush again.
exact.买家把笔裹进锦缎，连价都没还。你手里多了 25 银。: The buyer wraps the brush in brocade and does not even haggle. You have 25 silver more.
exact.你把笔封进匣子，埋回原处。世上少了一支能改命的笔，多了一个知道它存在的人。: You seal the brush in a case and bury it where it was. The world has one fewer brush that can change a fate, and one more person who knows it exists.
exact.匣子合上时，你听见很轻的一声，像有人把话咽了回去。: When the case closes you hear a very small sound, as if someone swallowed a sentence.
exact.你验明了笔，没有卖，也没有封。你带着它继续走。: You verified the brush, neither sold it nor sealed it. You walk on with it.
exact.你没有验它，但你信它。你把笔别在腰间，继续走。: You did not verify it, but you believe in it. You tuck the brush at your waist and walk on.
exact.十八天过去，你没找到笔，但你还在往山里去。: Eighteen days have passed. You did not find the brush, but you are still heading into the hills.
exact.你回了镇上，在酒馆里劝人别再找那支笔。故事比笔活得久。: You return to town and, in a tavern, tell people to stop looking for that brush. The story outlives the brush.
exact.粮尽了。你饿得眼前发黑，命 -1。: The food is gone. Hunger blacks out your sight. Life -1.
exact.断粮掉命，下次记得在渡口补干粮。: Running out of food costs life. Next time, restock rations at the ferry.
exact.墨债压得你每夜都咳（命 -1）。: Ink debt makes you cough every night (life -1).
exact.镇上粮价涨了：下一袋涨至 4 银。: Town grain has gone up: the next sack costs 4 silver.
exact.有人在驿道上拦你，收了 4 银才让路（夺笔者）。: Someone bars the post road and takes 4 silver before letting you pass (a brush-snatcher).
exact.拦路的人没拿到钱，给了你一刀（命 -1）。: The one who barred the road got no silver, and gave you a cut (life -1).
exact.听说有人在驿道上被抢了。你没东西可抢，也就没被拦。: You hear someone was robbed on the post road. You had nothing worth taking, so no one stopped you.
exact.封山了。之后每赶一次路要多吃一份干粮。: The hills are closed. Every later journey costs an extra ration.
exact.你在半路上倒下，粮和墨都耗尽了。: You fall mid-road. Food and ink are both spent.
exact.你没能走到第十八天。: You did not make it to the eighteenth day.
exact.笔在你身上，已经验明。: The brush is on you, and it has been verified.
exact.笔在你身上，但还没验明——现在落笔什么也不会发生。: The brush is on you, but it has not been verified — writing now will do nothing.
exact.粮见底时才开始补给，通常已经晚了。渡口是最便宜的补给点。: If you wait until food hits bottom to restock, it is usually too late. The ferry is the cheapest supply point.
exact.这一局没有留下可验的线索：信能让你更快下决定，也会让你更快走错。: This run left no verifiable lead. Belief lets you decide faster — and go wrong faster.
exact.验明之后卖掉，是最安全的变现方式，也是最低分的结局。: Verifying and then selling is the safest way to cash out, and the lowest-scoring ending.
exact.这一局没有明显失误，也没有明显侥幸。: This run had no obvious mistake, and no obvious luck.
exact.这一局还没收尾。: This run is not over yet.
exact.写下这一局你信了什么、验了什么，以及用笔那一下换来了什么。: Write down what you believed this run, what you verified, and what that one use of the brush bought you.
exact.写下这一局你追的线索、信与证的差距，以及最后为什么停在这里。: Write down the lead you chased, the gap between belief and proof, and why you stopped here.
exact.你主动收了壳。路还在，笔还在某个地方。: You shelled out on purpose. The road is still there, and the brush is still somewhere.
exact.十八幕游历，一支写下就成真的笔: Eighteen acts on the road, and a brush that makes writing come true
exact.传说有一支笔，写下什么就成什么。你是归墟镇外的一只龙虾，带着银、粮和一条命，在六: Legend says there is a brush: write a thing, and the thing becomes true. You are a lobster outside Ruin-Return Town, with silver, food, and one life, walking eighteen acts among six places: ask, verify, dig, write, sell, or seal. The deeper you believe, the easier it is to hear what you want. The firmer the proof, the more you dare stake a life on one patch of ground. The brush's gains are real. So is the ink debt's backlash.
exact.每幕只有一个动作。travel:<site> 走路，注意粮：每幕固定 -1，断粮: One action per act. travel:<site> walks the road. Watch food: -1 each act, and an empty bag costs life.
exact.investigate 花 2 银打听线索，信（belief）越高越容易听见「你: investigate spends 2 silver to ask for a lead. Higher belief makes it easier to hear what you want to hear.
exact.线索要到荒庙 temple 用 verify 验证：真线索涨证（proof），假: Take a lead to the deserted temple and verify it: a true lead raises proof, a false one lowers belief.
exact.dig 只能在野址挖，一次 1 命。只有站在真笔址、且信 >= 60 或证 >=: dig only works at a wild site and costs 1 life. You find it only if you stand on the true site and belief >= 60 or proof meets the threshold.
exact.挖到笔不等于能用：到荒庙 probe 三次验明，或靠信 >= 60 / 证 >=: Finding the brush is not the same as using it. Probe three times at the temple, or open it directly with belief >= 60 / proof >= 3.
exact.开笔后 write:heal / write:gold / write:eras: Once open, write:heal / write:gold / write:erase each add ink debt. From debt >= 3, backlash can come; at >= 5 you lose life each act; at >= 6 the ink eats you and the run ends.
exact.皇驿 post 可以 settle:sell 卖笔（25 银 + 4 名望，永久: At the imperial post you can settle:sell the brush (25 silver + 4 fame, gone for good) or settle:seal it (+6 fame).
exact.没找到笔也能收尾：信得深是「寻笔」，不信而一路劝人是「劝世」，把经历写成书稿同样: You can finish without finding the brush. Deep belief is "seeking the brush"; disbelief spent counseling others is "counseling the world." Writing the journey into a manuscript also scores.
exact.验明之后卖掉，是把笔换成银子的退路，天梯分远低于封笔或带着验明的笔走。: Selling after you verify it cashes the pen out. The ladder score is far below sealing it, or walking on with a verified pen.
